crossRefs.note: Moses did as Yahweh commanded. They went up onto Mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.

people.name: Hor_Mount
people.line: Mountain where Aaron died and was buried

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses did as Yahweh commanded. They went up onto Mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.
translations.bsb: So Moses did as the LORD had commanded, and they climbed Mount Hor in the sight of the whole congregation.
translations.kjv: And Moses did as the LORD commanded: and they went up into mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.
translations.asv: And Moses did as Jehovah commanded: and they went up into mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.
